To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) The use of cloud-based computation offloading in robotics is a viable approach, 2) The use of the cloud for low level tasks, like navigation assistance, improves the performance of the robot and the quality of the navigation results, 3) The use of different communication technologies and cloud-based models for offloading has a significant effect on the performance and the results, 4) A real case of navigation in a domestic circuit demonstrates that offloading computation improves the performance of navigation.
cloud computing can improve performance in the robot navigation assistance task, and it can be done with a good tradeoff between performance, cost and reliability.
the cloud offloading is a valid option for the case of the navigation assistance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of the cloud as an offloading platform for the navigation of a service robot.
the analysis of the tradeoff between performance and latency of the robot navigation, and the use of the cloud as a computation resource.
the use of Cloud Computing to offload intensive computing tasks in robotics, and in particular, in a low level task: the navigation assistance of a mobile robot.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the use of cloud computing is a good alternative for the use of a mobile robot in a real environment, as it allows a more reliable navigation and the robot is able to process the information of the whole environment, instead of only its local perception.
, in the case of this application, the use of Cloud Computing as a computational resource is a good choice, as long as the communication is fast and reliable enough.
offloading computation is feasible for low level tasks and it improves the navigation performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of Cloud Computing in this case is feasible, and it can be used to improve the performance of the system, but it is not the only solution to improve the performance.
Cloud Computing can be used for offloading computation tasks, but the use of a high-bandwidth communication technology is needed to achieve good results.
the use of Cloud Computing as a complement for mobile robots is a feasible option for low level intensive computing tasks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of the Cloud for low-level and intensive tasks, such as image processing, can be a viable option in the robotics area.
the Cloud is a good option for the computation offloading of low-level intensive tasks, like the navigation of a service robot.
cloud computing is suitable for offloading low-level and computationally intensive tasks in mobile robot navigation, and that this is a viable alternative to current embedded solutions.
